profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an AI governance company founded in 2020 that describes itself as having created the AI governance category. Its platform is designed to help enterprises discover their AI systems, enforce policies, manage risk, and demonstrate compliance across models, agents, and applications. The company says its platform is powered by a Knowledge Graph that combines regulatory intelligence with business context, and it offers more than 300 integrations along with what it describes as forward-deployed governance experts.

The core product, also called Credo AI, is a purpose-built AI governance and risk management platform. It includes pre-built policy packs covering the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, and it provides agent-level governance as a distinct capability, including registry, risk assessment, and controls for AI agents. The platform also includes GAIA, a Govern AI Assistant described as generally available, which the company says compresses weeks of governance work into hours. Credo AI states it is ranked No. 6 in Applied AI on Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026, alongside Google, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic. Named customers and partners referenced on the site include Mastercard and IBM.

The held facts show no litigation on record and no MCP server presence. The company's profile on theworldofai.org was verified as of August 31, 2026.
